title: Paul's Confrontation with Cephas in Antioch
description: When Cephas came to Antioch, Paul opposed him to his face because he had withdrawn from eating with the Gentiles out of fear of those who were circumcised by James. Even Barnabas was carried away by their hypocrisy. Paul rebuked Cephas publicly and proclaimed that a person is not justified by works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ.
